title: 2D Texture Array
summary: Official Derivative texturing page contrasting 2D Texture Arrays with 3D Textures, including Texture 3D TOP and GLSL TOP creation paths, non-normalized W slice indexing, no between-slice blending, per-slice mipmaps, and GLSL sampler2DArray usage.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs discrete texture slices rather than a normalized, blended 3D texture volume.
Sample a 2D Texture Array with non-normalized W slice coordinates: 0 for the first slice, 1 for the second slice, and so on.
Do not expect between-slice blending from the sampler; blend slices manually in GLSL if fractional selection is needed.
Enable GL_EXT_texture_array and use sampler2DArray plus texture2DArray(samplerName, vec3) for GLSL array sampling.
Choose 2D Texture Arrays over 3D Textures when per-slice mipmapping matters.
